Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

steps.input:
{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-22c98e24.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform separator rows/columns are the lines whose cells all have one
    # color, distinct from the repeated background and marker.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # The divider color is the most frequent among these uniform lines.
    from collections import Counter
    line_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols]
    divider = Counter(line_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v not in (divider, bg))
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if n > 1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,4,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,4,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[4,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,4,5,5,5],[7]*19,[5,5,5,5,7,5,4,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,4,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,4,4,7,4,5,5,5]]
